# jurisdiction

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:jurisdiction`](gmeow-jurisdiction.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/jurisdiction>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)

The legal or regulatory jurisdiction of a specific identifier (e.g., company registration jurisdiction) — a country, state, province, or other [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md). Non-functional: different identifiers may carry different jurisdictions.
